prompt: window-limiter.js implements SlidingWindowLimiter({ windowMs, maxRequests }) as a CommonJS module. Fix the bugs in allow(key, nowMs) and remaining(key, nowMs): (1) requests at or older than nowMs - windowMs (ts <= nowMs - windowMs) must expire from the active window; (2) denied requests must NOT be recorded in the window; (3) remaining(key, nowMs) must prune expired entries before computing remaining capacity; (4) out-of-order timestamps must never produce negative retryAfterMs (clamp to >= 0). Keep the exported class and method signatures intact.
